method: tools/lanec/cover.py: every host case of each suite run alone through build/lanec-cover/lanec-native (-O0 --coverage, with LANEC_COVER_SITES so each call of a shared helper (lanec_ccs, lanec_ccs_a, lanec_ts, lanec_ev_zero, lanec_ev_nonpositive, lanec_ev_mp) branches on its outcome at the call line) and the branch arcs it takes in every linked source read with gcov -b (tools/c64_row_cover.py); the C64 rows are the cases frozen in tests/lanec_<suite>_c64.h (every case when the suite has none), and their arcs are compared with the whole host suite's; with --pool, a host arc of one suite counts as taken on the C64 when the C64 rows of any suite in the record take it (the same source line and branch in the same build)
